translations.EN: Mask up. We keep the camp safe together.
translations.TL: Mask up. We keep the camp safe together.

translations.EN: Put your mask back on. Knox is airborne.
translations.TL: Put your mask back on. Knox is airborne.

translations.EN: Put your mask on, family. I am not losing you to the air.
translations.TL: Put your mask on, family. I am not losing you to the air.

translations.EN: Put your mask back on. The air is not safe.
translations.TL: Put your mask back on. The air is not safe.

translations.EN: Put your mask back on before you become a problem.
translations.TL: Put your mask back on before you become a problem.

translations.EN: Please put your mask back on, love. This air is not safe.
translations.TL: Please put your mask back on, love. This air is not safe.
